who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor of plan 9 task 1, int-1112
what: Making every node kind public as a const_ast::Kind, 'every SyntaxKind from ABI on' is not every node kind: eight contextual keywords (UNWRAP_BINDER_KW .. UNIQ_KW) are numbered after the nodes to keep older kinds' numbers, and kinds_are_the_grammars decided token-or-node by `number < ABI`, so it would have written a keyword's line without TOKEN.
cost: one wrong rule found by reading; would have made 8 token kinds openable as nodes
cause: whether a kind is a token is read off its position in the numbering, which stopped being true when kinds were appended out of order
class: a property derived from an order that later appends do not keep
prevention: token-or-node is `number < ABI || !SyntaxKind::text().is_empty()` in both kinds tests; the parser could carry an is_token table generated with the enum
fix: kinds.rs holds the 178 node kinds; kinds_are_the_grammars and every_node_kind_is_public use the text rule; every_node_kind_is_public's control drops IMPL and is caught naming it.
